**Still live (verified this run):** slices 1 (#958) and 3 (#959) are unimplemented on main and the design record is still in open PR #957, so the scope flip this issue performs would, by its own reasoning, only multiply gopls processes if done today. No merged PR addresses it.

**Related:** #958 (slice 1) · #959 (slice 3) · #960 (slice 2, explicitly not required) · #864 (fleet `.mcpx.json` absolute `/home/user` paths — this slice wants the post-#864 config shape or an explicit note on why it proceeded anyway) · PR #957 (decision 0004, open) · origins dezren39/nix#817 / dezren39/nix#819.

**Notes / risks:** Marked `status/blocked` at intake — deliberately last in the set. Its acceptance is a *live proof*, not unit tests: the 2026-10-25 baseline (empty `go_package_api` result after 156 s) is the regression to beat, and the proof must run from a linked worktree as well as the main checkout, with both machines' fleet configs staying identical.

**Suggested approach:** Only after #958 + #959 land: flip `gopls-mcp-server` to `"scope": "worktree"` in the fleet config, then run the two-checkout proof and record timings + `mcpx status` root output on this issue.

— Fleet monitor intake enrichment (acceptance criteria were already in the body; labels normalized, `meta/enriched` added).

**Evidence (fresh GitHub reads at main HEAD `e561ab58`):**
- `.mcpx.json` at HEAD: the `gopls-mcp-server` entry is `{command: "go", args: ["run", "golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest", "mcp"]}` with **no `mcpx.scope` block at all** — it has not been flipped to `"scope": "worktree"` (contrast `chrome-devtools`, which carries `mcpx: {sharing: "exclusive", scope: "session"}`). - Dependency states, checked fresh: slice 1 **#958 CLOSED** (scope resolved from spawn cwd — landed); related **#864 CLOSED**; but slice 3 **#959 is still OPEN** ("mcpx initialize: send the scope-resolved root as rootUri / workspaceFolders").

**Why gated:** this issue is deliberately last in decision record 0004's ordering — "flipping scopes before the spawn-cwd and initialize work landed would only multiply processes." The spawn-cwd half (#958) has landed; the initialize half (#959) has not. Flipping gopls to worktree scope now would run it against an initialize handshake that doesn't yet send the scope-resolved root, so the live proof in the acceptance criteria (`go_package_api` returning the module's real API promptly behind the fixed spawn cwd **and** initialize root) cannot pass yet.

**Route:** no fix packet enqueued yet — that would invite exactly the premature flip the decision record warns against. This issue is re-queued (`queue/queued` + `status/needs-triage`) for fleet-monitor reconciliation; the next triage pass should re-check #959 first, and once #959 closes, enqueue the slice-4 `small_fix` (flip `gopls-mcp-server` to `"scope": "worktree"` in the fleet config on both machines' identical server lists + the live `go_package_api` proof). This triage task completes as `triaged`.
